description: Sets the logical databases a user connects to (databases: a list, or null for all of them, future ones included) and whether it only reads; a field left out keeps its value. Applied within seconds; where its access is removed or lowered, its open connections are closed, so tell the user first if an application uses it. Not on the admin (it always has every database) nor on Valkey. Scope: databases.write.

database.description: Database id, as returned by list_databases or create_database.

items.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _.

databases.description: Logical databases it may connect to; null for all of them, future ones included.

username.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter or _.

name: set_database_user_access
title: Change a database user's access
